issues.explanation: Chapter 58 already says Xu Huang and Zhu Ling secretly crossed at Puban Ferry and that the Wei River crossing occurred. Chapter 59 again says Cao Cao ordered Xu Huang and Zhu Ling to cross the river, making the same operation seem to happen twice without clarification.
issues.suggested_fix: Rephrase as a continuation or consequence of their earlier crossing, or remove the repeated crossing detail.
